text:
The court should most likely apply Washington law and deny the punitive damages claim. As a federal court sitting in Washington, it applies Washington's choice-of-law rules, which use the most-significant-relationship test, and Washington's public policy against punitive damages weighs heavily against California's place-of-injury rule. I read "prevailing parties" in the question as meaning California permits punitive damages, and I have not checked current Washington authority on this point.

CONFIDENCE: 55
